questions.stem: What type of ions do metals typically form?
questions.explanation: Metals typically form positive ions (cations) by losing their outer shell electrons. Non-metals, by contrast, tend to form negative ions (anions) by gaining electrons or share electrons in covalent bonds.

options.text: A metal that is liquid at room temperature
An element with properties of both metals and non-metals
A compound containing a metal and a non-metal

questions.explanation: Metalloids (or semi-metals) are elements with properties intermediate between metals and non-metals. They are found along the stepped line in the Periodic Table. Examples include silicon and germanium, which are used as semiconductors.
